the following dates are applicable for admission to junior infants 2027. the school will commence accepting applications for admission on monday 2nd november 202 6. the school shall cease accepting applications for admission on monday 16th november 2026. applicants will be notified of the decision on their application on monday 7th december 2026 . applicants must confirm acceptance of an offer of admission by monday 21st december 2026. raphoe diocesan society the raphoe diocesan society was founded in 1874. in november of each year an annual mass for the deceased members of the society is offered in a different parish. the annual mass for 2026 will be in st columba’s church, glenswilly on tuesday 17th november at 7:30pm. celebrant will be most rev. niall coll, bishop of raphoe. to enrol a person in the rds contact your local priest or email
